description: Design of isolated buildings to achieve targeted collapse limits through Gaussian Process Modeling is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Huy Pham, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). Although ASCE 7 provisions provide for adequate collapse likelihoods of fixed-based, conventional structures, these targets are not well-calibrated for isolated structures. Furthermore, design parameters are not altered for isolated structures even for enhanced targets. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: moment frames, base isolation, triple friction pendulum, collapse probability. Published 2024-10-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
